# About Our Staff

Learn more about the professionals who work hard at Pinnacle Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc., to ensure each customer is taken care of.

Established in 1993, our company takes pride in professionalism. You'll get the best possible craftsmanship and customer service when you work with us.

![Paul J. Eyerman, Jr.](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/11715380+%281%29-1920w.jpg)

### Paul J. Eyerman, Jr.

President of the company with 35 years of experience in the roofing industry.

![Jerome F. Devlin](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/11715377+%281%29-1920w.jpg)

### Jerome F. Devlin

Vice President of Operations with 30 years of experience in the roofing industry.

![John Racht](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/11715378+%281%29-1920w.jpg)

### John Racht

An increase in roofing construction in the Scranton area deemed it necessary to create a satellite office in Dickson City. With over 35 years of experience in the roofing industry, John Racht is the Superintendent of Operations at the Dickson City facility.

![Mariann 2016](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/12255054_200x190+%281%29-1920w.jpg)

### Mariann Eyerman

Mariann is the Company Secretary and Office Manager. Her responsibilities include accounting, bookkeeping, and all financial needs for Pinnacle Roofing & Sheet Metal, Inc.

Get an environmentally-friendly roof! We're a part of the Energy Star Savings Program.

![Awards](https://le-cdn.hibuwebsites.com/983869aca4494363a1e28ddf9dfabe34/dms3rep/multi/opt/11717457+%281%29-1920w.jpg)
